decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: LM/44SC – 01 Rev A, LM/44SC – 02 Rev A, LM/44SC – 03 Rev A, LM/44SC - 08A Rev A, LM/44SC - 09A Rev A, LM/44SC - 10A Rev A, Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Preliminary Ecological Report, Fire Safety Compliance Statement, Arboricultural Survey-BS5837:2012, Existing and Proposed Site Plan.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  west flank elevation of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replace garage door with window in front elevation, Single storey rear extension, Replace window with Juliette balcony in first floor rear elevation, External alterations (Demolition of attached garage)
